config.name: f6ev_pseudo2025
config._doc: configs/f6_final.json (f5 + the grade-A events layer) on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members, as f5_pseudo2025.json. The events layer is refitted per held month on f5's own rehearsal rows of the other three months (f5_pseudo2025_{mode}.parquet, col post4_recovered, the prediction entering the layer); the layer checks that the held month's entering values equal that column.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.

recipe.name: f6ev_pseudo2025
recipe._doc: f6 = f5 plus the grade-A ADS-B pushback blend (research/final/levers/events.py) as the last post layer, after the second recovered layer, so the L1a-v2 loadings need no refit. On rows with an ADS-B v3 grade-A event (seen parked, then seen leaving) and 0 <= a3_obs_leave <= max(d, 1 h): y_hat + w(|y_e - y_hat| bin, d <= 1 h / d > 1 h) (y_e - y_hat), y_e = a3_obs_leave + the airport's median offset; offsets and weights fitted on f5's frozen 2025 rehearsal rows (research/final/levers/artifacts/events_f5.json). Everything else is f5. Lever 1 of research/final/headroom/RESULTS.md.
notes: Level calibration: composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF (research/cache/oof_mo12_c6.parquet), lam 0.75, cap 0.05.
Post layers: research/final/levers (lv_rules.py, recovered.py, daily.py); described in docs/METHOD.md sections 3 and 4 (Step 7).
mlp7: 6 seeds (prc-f-mlp7m6: r2912 from prc-f-mlp7a, r2911/r2913 from prc-f-mlp7c, r2914-r2916 from prc-f-mlp7b).
Segment weights fitted on the 2025 month-out predictions (four months, rows without date-shift artifacts or short-delay y > 3 h); the long stack keeps f3's A/B weights.
c6s, c5s and x5: 6 seeds (prc-f-c6s + prc-f-c6sb, prc-f-c5s + prc-f-c5sb, prc-f-x5 + prc-f-x5b; research/final/merge_members.py). fs8 c7: 6 seeds (prc-f8-c7a + prc-f8-c7b).

d <= 1 h segment: meta member meta-g1short = solutions/kernels/prc-meta-gbm-f4/output/final_G1.parquet (docs/METHOD.md section 2, Step 1, "d <= 1 h: the G1short meta-model"). Rehearsal f5 - f4, crossfit vs crossfit, two passes: nw -49.0 [-85.4, -12.2]; without LTFM February -17.6 [-45.3, +11.5] (docs/VALIDATION.md, Paired comparisons of complete pipelines).

L1a-v2 loadings refitted on f5's frozen pass-1 rows (submissions/final/meta/pseudo2025/meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1_frozen.parquet, col post2_recovered): python3 research/final/levers/daily.py v2 --rows <that file> --col post2_recovered --out research/final/meta/artifacts/daily_v2_f5_loadings.json.

meta-g1short upstream files (kernel output, the dataset's local files, the build and kernel code) are listed under its 'inputs' and hashed in the manifest; the d <= 1 h members c7, cs7, mlp7 and fs8 c7 enter f5 only through it.

Events layer (post layer 5, research/final/levers/events.py): grade-A rows only (grades B/C/D never move); bins of |y_e - y_hat| at 60/180/600/1,800 s; weights clipped to [0, 1]; after the blend the moved rows get the cap d (d > 2 h), lv_rules (a)+(d), the recovered-orphan window and the floor, then the assembler's rules step as in f5. Artifact: python3 research/final/levers/events.py artifact (fitted on all four months of submissions/final/pseudo2025/f5_pseudo2025_frozen.parquet, column post4_recovered).
